hero.name: Mauro Gerardi
hero.subtitle: Front-End Developer & Business Analyst
hero.tagline: I build accessible, data-heavy web apps with React, TypeScript and Angular — and turn business needs into features that ship.

presentation.title: Nice to meet you
presentation.body: I'm a front-end developer with 5+ years building web platforms — from Argentina's national e-procurement portals (COMPR.AR / CONTRAT.AR) to the Moorea SaaS, and lately my own products: a veterinary clinic management system and an e-commerce with Mercado Pago. I work mostly with React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS (Angular and .NET before that), and as a Business Analyst I spend as much time understanding the problem as writing the code. University Technical Degree in Web Development, UNER.

frontend.title: Front-End Development
frontend.description: Accessible, responsive interfaces in React, TypeScript and Angular — built mobile-first and tested before they ship.

analysis.title: Business Analysis
analysis.description: I map and improve business processes, write functional specs and user stories, and act as the bridge between stakeholders and the technical team.

platforms.title: SaaS & Web Platforms
platforms.description: End-to-end product work, from gathering requirements to shipping the final experience: dashboards, e-commerce, admin panels and public portals.

latestProjects.title: Latest projects
latestProjects.subtitle: Two products designed, built and shipped end to end in 2026.

testimonials.title: Testimonials
testimonials.subtitle: What people I've worked with say

armando.name: Armando Trillo
armando.title: Information Systems graduate · teammate on the COMPR.AR / CONTRAT.AR Scrum team
armando.quote: Mauro has demonstrated a positive, proactive attitude and strong commitment, adapting to the rapid changes in the project. He has overcome challenges and grown with each new role assigned to him: developer, incident manager, coordination, and training of teammates. He has a special ability as a Business Analyst to understand and describe business operational flows, integrating that knowledge into the code as a developer. He has a very well-rounded profile and has been a great colleague on the C&C Scrum Team.

tamara.name: Tamara Martínez
tamara.title: UX/UI Designer · freelance collaborator
tamara.quote: It was a real pleasure working with Mauro, and I hope to work with him again. He is definitely the kind of developer you can trust with a project from start to finish. He has a great ability to understand project requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions. In addition, his attention to detail and commitment to quality are evident in every line of code he writes. He is always willing to collaborate and contribute ideas to improve the final product. I highly recommend Mauro for any web development project.

profile.title: About me
profile.objectives: A product-minded, remote team where I can own features end to end — from analysis to a polished, accessible interface — and keep growing toward a senior front-end role.
profile.aptitudes: Organized and detail-oriented; I write clear specs and clear code, communicate early with stakeholders, and take ownership from requirement to release.

uner.degree: University Technical Degree in Web Development

skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: Technologies and tools I use in production.

techLead.description: Led the development team of COMPR.AR and CONTRAT.AR, Argentina's national procurement platforms (Chief of Cabinet of Ministers, operated by the National Procurement Office — ONC): priorities, code reviews, estimates and releases on a .NET, Angular Material and SQL stack, plus the day-to-day link with the ONC's functional team.

businessAnalyst.description: Analyzed and documented business processes for Leafnoise's clients, wrote functional specifications and user stories, and acted as the bridge between stakeholders and developers so that what shipped matched what the business needed.

frontendDev.description: Front-end developer of Moorea, Leafnoise's process-management SaaS, and its public site. I take features from requirement to release — UI components, forms, data tables and workflow screens in React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS (Angular + Angular Material earlier on) — always from the user's point of view.

fullStack.description: Maintenance and evolution of COMPR.AR and CONTRAT.AR: bug fixing and new features across the .NET back end, the Angular Material front end and the SQL database, working with the ONC's functional team.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Products I have built — from national procurement portals to SaaS and e-commerce.

abrilVet.subtitle: Veterinary clinic management SaaS
abrilVet.description: All-in-one management platform for veterinary clinics: clients and patients, agenda, medical records, vaccinations, lab studies, surgeries and hospitalizations, billing, POS sales, inventory, purchases, cash register, reports and role-based staff access — with light and dark mode. Designed and built end to end as a solo developer. The public URL shows the login screen; demo access on request.
abrilVet.role: Solo developer — product, UX, front end and back end
highlights: Role-based access (admin / vet / receptionist / assistant) with Firebase Auth custom claims and Firestore security rules
Vercel Functions back end on the Firebase Admin SDK, with staff invitations by email (Resend)
Cloudinary uploads for photos, studies and PDFs; 15+ feature modules behind one consistent UI

carili.subtitle: E-commerce for handmade ceramic sinks
carili.description: Online store for an Argentine ceramics studio that sells handmade bathroom sinks: catalog with search and filters, cart, checkout with Mercado Pago (payment webhook), order tracking, customer accounts and an admin panel for products, orders, users, site content and contact messages.
carili.role: Solo developer — storefront, admin panel and payments
highlights: Mercado Pago Checkout with a server-side webhook that confirms orders
Admin panel to manage products, orders, users, content and messages without touching code
CI on GitHub Actions (lint, type-check, tests) and continuous deploys on Vercel

saasMoorea.subtitle: Process management and automation SaaS
saasMoorea.description: Moorea's SaaS lets organizations model, run and track internal procedures (requests, approvals, document flows) from one dashboard. I build the React front end — new modules, forms, data tables and the process-flow screens — turning stakeholder requirements into shipped features, and I write the functional specs as the team's Business Analyst.
highlights: New modules, forms and data tables in React + TypeScript, from requirement to release
Process-flow screens that let teams model and track their internal procedures
Functional specs and user stories written as the team's Business Analyst

moorea.subtitle: Product website for Moorea
moorea.description: Public site for the Moorea product: value proposition, features, FAQ and the AI demo entry point that funnels visitors into the SaaS. A fast, responsive marketing site in React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.
highlights: Responsive marketing site in React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS
Value proposition, features and FAQ sections that funnel visitors into the SaaS
Same design language as the product for a seamless hand-off

leafnoise.subtitle: Corporate website of Leafnoise Company
leafnoise.description: Website of the software company behind Moorea: services, digital-transformation offering and contact. A responsive React + Tailwind CSS site.
highlights: Services and digital-transformation offering in a clear, scannable layout
Responsive React + Tailwind CSS build
Contact flow for inbound business inquiries

comprar.subtitle: Argentina's national e-procurement system
comprar.description: COMPR.AR is the electronic purchasing system of the National Public Administration (Chief of Cabinet of Ministers, operated by the National Procurement Office — ONC): agencies publish tenders and suppliers bid online. I joined as a full-stack developer maintaining the .NET + Angular Material + SQL platform and later led the development team as Tech Lead.
comprar.role: Full-Stack Developer → Tech Lead — Leafnoise for the ONC
highlights: Maintenance and new features across the .NET back end, the Angular Material front end and the SQL database
Led the development team as Tech Lead: priorities, code reviews, estimates and releases
Day-to-day link with the National Procurement Office's functional team

contratar.subtitle: Public works contracts and concessions portal
contratar.description: Sister platform of COMPR.AR for public-works contracts and concessions: agencies run their tendering processes and construction companies submit bids online. Same team and stack (.NET, Angular Material, SQL): maintenance, new features and team coordination for the ONC.
contratar.role: Full-Stack Developer → Tech Lead — Leafnoise for the ONC
highlights: Sister platform of COMPR.AR, built and maintained by the same team on the same stack
Tendering for public works: agencies publish, construction companies bid online
Maintenance, new features and team coordination for the ONC

libretas.subtitle: ANSES — Libreta AUH yearly compliance system
libretas.description: System ANSES uses to register and validate the yearly Libreta AUH — the proof of health check-ups, vaccination and school attendance that Universal Child Allowance families must submit. Delivered by the Leafnoise team on .NET, Angular Material and SQL.
highlights: Yearly registration and validation of the Libreta AUH for Universal Child Allowance families
Health check-up, vaccination and school-attendance data in one workflow
Leafnoise team delivery on .NET, Angular Material and SQL

certificados.subtitle: ANSES — school attendance certificates
certificados.description: System to issue and validate the annual school-attendance certificate required for ANSES's Ayuda Escolar Anual benefit, used by schools, families and ANSES staff. Delivered by the Leafnoise team on .NET, Angular Material and SQL.
highlights: Issuing and validating the annual certificate behind the Ayuda Escolar Anual benefit
One flow for schools, families and ANSES staff
Leafnoise team delivery on .NET, Angular Material and SQL

portal.subtitle: Santa Fe province — single portal for citizen procedures
portal.description: Public, login-free portal where citizens of Santa Fe browse every provincial procedure, in person or online, with requirements, steps and direct access to the digital ones. Front-end work in React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.
portal.role: Front-End Developer — Leafnoise team (for the Province of Santa Fe)
highlights: Catalogue of every provincial procedure with its requirements and steps
Public access without authentication, with direct entry to the online procedures
Front end in React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS
